data.name: Hashim
data.gender_notes: Hashim is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Breaker of bread; one who provides
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ه-ش-م (h-sh-m), 'to break, crush' — 'one who breaks bread for others'. Its root is ه-ش-م (h-sh-m). Hāshim, great-grandfather of the Prophet ﷺ; ancestor of the Hāshimites. Hashim is a Arabic name meaning “Breaker of bread; one who provides”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hashim expresses “Breaker of bread; one who provides”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ه-ش-م (h-sh-m), 'to break, crush' — 'one who breaks bread for others'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hashim total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
